doc: What this repository tells the harness about itself. The context sources are where a role is pointed before it starts; edit the globs to match where your documents and tests live. No integration is on: add `"integrations": {"beads": true}` if you use the Beads tracker, and `"knowledge_base": true` beside it to have `kb` say whether your knowledge stores are up.
